name: hdi
title: Human development, income, night-time lights and population
description: An annual panel of Cambodia's 17 Global Data Lab (GDL) subnational regions, 2013–2019. It combines the Global Data Lab's subnational Human Development Index (HDI), gross national income (GNI) and population with harmonized DMSP-like night-time lights (NTL). Some GDL regions group several present-day provinces; for example, KH-GDL-13 is Battambang plus Pailin (see `geo/units.csv`).

sources.title: Smits, J., & Permanyer, I. (2019). The Subnational Human Development Database. Scientific Data, 6, 190038.
Li, X., Zhou, Y., Zhao, M., & Zhao, X. (2020). A harmonized global nighttime light dataset 1992–2018. Scientific Data, 7, 168.

geo:citation: GeoDevelopment Observatory of Cambodia (2025). Human development, income, (DMSP-like) lights and population in Cambodia (17 Global Data Lab regions, 2013–2019). https://github.com/quarcs-lab/geo4cambodia/blob/main/docs/datasets/hdi.md
geo:notes: `lnGNIpc` is the natural log of `GNIpc`. The source panel computed it as log(GNIpc × 10^8 / POP), dividing by population twice; the builder recomputes it from `GNIpc`.
`lnNTLpc` is log(NTL × 10^8 / POP) as in the source panel (POP in thousands): a log of lights per capita shifted by a constant.
GDL region boundaries are dissolved from the GADM districts of their member provinces, so they nest exactly in the country and contain whole provinces.
